name: anti-hall
description: Verify-first discipline for Claude Code. SessionStart injects the full Iron-Law + rationalization-table protocol, the always-on SCOPE & FIDELITY discipline (simplest sufficient solution, intent over letter, confirm before expanding scope, match rigor to blast radius, finish asked work / drop nothing), and a skill primer (and re-injects it after compaction, since SessionStart re-fires with source=compact); a per-turn UserPromptSubmit hook adds a short varying nudge. Skills: root-cause debugging, orchestration (non-blocking swarm), ship-it (one lean plan-mode + Workflow-swarm + deadly-loop-gated workflow scaled S/M/L to blast radius), deadly-loop, handover (comprehensive session handoff so a fresh session can resume without re-deriving or guessing anything). Ships api-guard (blocks fabricated stdlib/builtin APIs in code, verified against the installed python3/node; opt-in 3rd-party via ANTIHALL_API_GUARD_THIRDPARTY=1), git-guard (blocks force-push + AI self-credit in commit trailers AND gh pr/issue/release bodies), task discipline, and a monorepo/simple statusline (plus a repo-root AGENTS.md Codex mirror for clone-based use — not bundled by /plugin install). Also ships an OPT-IN mcp-reaper companion (macOS + Linux) — a pure-Node background job that kills ONLY orphaned MCP-server processes (parent already died); install via `node plugins/anti-hall/companion/install-reaper.js` (Windows is a documented no-op). All hooks and the statusline are pure Node (built-ins only) and run unchanged on macOS and Linux; Windows is untested and not officially supported. REQUIRES Node.js >= 22 on PATH: hooks are launched as `node <hook>.js`; without Node, the hooks (including the git-guard safety) silently do not run (intentional — a shell-based preflight cannot reach stock Windows systems, so we omit it by design). Verify with `node --version` before relying on protections. Includes a separate Codex-native port under plugins/anti-hall/codex with a .codex-plugin manifest, Codex hook-subset installer, OMX-oriented skills, context-conservation and ship-it protocols; Claude hook files remain unchanged.

auto_handover_enabled.title: Auto Handover · Enabled
auto_handover_enabled.description: Write an automatic session handover before context runs out.

auto_handover_pct.title: Auto Handover · Threshold %
auto_handover_pct.description: Context-usage percent that triggers an automatic handover.

auto_handover_max_tokens.title: Auto Handover · Token ceiling (0 = off)
auto_handover_max_tokens.description: Opt-in absolute context-token ceiling that also triggers the handover, whichever of pct/maxTokens fires first; 0 (the default) = no ceiling — the real per-session context window size (85% of it) is the only trigger unless a user explicitly sets this.

auto_handover_nag.title: Auto Handover · Nag reminders
auto_handover_nag.description: Remind the user when a handover is due but not yet written.

auto_handover_nag_step_pct.title: Auto Handover · Nag step %
auto_handover_nag_step_pct.description: Percent increments between successive handover nags.

auto_handover_nag_quiet_min.title: Auto Handover · Nag quiet minutes
auto_handover_nag_quiet_min.description: Minutes to wait before repeating a handover nag.

auto_handover_gate_new_work.title: Auto Handover · Gate new work after handover
auto_handover_gate_new_work.description: After the auto-handover is written, the agent sizes each new request first and offers to park anything bigger than the budget until after /compact or /clear (or proceed if you insist). Quick questions, the in-flight task, and DevSwarm spawns pass through.

auto_handover_gate_budget_pct.title: Auto Handover · Post-handover budget (%)
auto_handover_gate_budget_pct.description: Context-window points a new request may use after the handover before the gate applies; one reminder fires once usage grows this far past where the handover was saved.

auto_handover_decisive_prompt.title: Auto Handover · Decisive compact/clear prompt
auto_handover_decisive_prompt.description: At a turn-ending Stop point once this session's handover exists and is fresh, end the reply with one prominent line naming the exact /compact (or /clear, or Codex /new) command — or, if the handover has gone stale, refresh it first.

guards_merge_gate.title: Guards · Merge-readiness gate
guards_merge_gate.description: Enable merge-readiness gate checks before merging.

guards_failure_root_cause_nudge.title: Guards · Failure root-cause nudge
guards_failure_root_cause_nudge.description: Nudge toward root-cause analysis after a failure.

guards_stash_guard.title: Guards · Stash guard
guards_stash_guard.description: Arm the git-stash guard in command-guard: block mutating git stash (also armed per-repo via .anti-hall/protected-stashes). Safety guard: only you can disarm it (here or via env); agents cannot.

guards_injection_repeat_every.title: Guards · Injection repeat-every (turns)
guards_injection_repeat_every.description: Turns between full re-injections of a static UserPromptSubmit reminder block (VERIFY-FIRST, the DEVSWARM PRIMARY dispatch-tier/top-fan-out-tier suffixes) once its first-turn/post-compact copy has been consumed; 0 restores every-turn injection.

guards_codex_quota_detect.title: Guards · Codex quota detect
guards_codex_quota_detect.description: Detect a Codex-CLI quota/rate-limit exhaustion message in a codex:codex-rescue Agent result and record it so other lanes stop rediscovering the outage independently.

version_alerts_anti_hall.title: Version Alerts · anti-hall updates
version_alerts_anti_hall.description: Alert when a newer anti-hall version is available.

version_alerts_claude_cli.title: Version Alerts · Claude Code CLI updates
version_alerts_claude_cli.description: Alert when a newer Claude CLI version is available.

version_alerts_devswarm.title: Version Alerts · DevSwarm updates
version_alerts_devswarm.description: Alert when a newer DevSwarm/hivecontrol version is available.

updates_allow_cache_prune.title: Updates / Maintenance · Allow doctor --prune-cache
updates_allow_cache_prune.description: Enables the opt-in doctor --prune-cache verb. It never runs automatically; without --confirmed it only lists the old plugin cache version dirs it would remove. Keeps the newest 3, the registered install, every version a live process runs from, and the running version.

limit_conserve_mode.title: Limit Conservation · Mode
limit_conserve_mode.description: Force usage-limit conservation on/off, or auto-detect. Allowed: auto | on | off.

limit_conserve_threshold.title: Limit Conservation · Threshold %
limit_conserve_threshold.description: Usage percent that triggers conservation mode.

jev_enabled.title: Jev · Enabled
jev_enabled.description: Enable the opt-in Jev semantic decision engine.

jev_transport.title: Jev · Transport
jev_transport.description: Vercel AI Gateway passthrough (default) or a direct TypeSafe API call. Allowed: vercel | typesafe.

jev_judge_model.title: Jev · Judge model
jev_judge_model.description: Model used for speculation-judge / jev-triage LLM calls.

jev_budget_mode.title: Jev · Budget mode
jev_budget_mode.description: Jev spend: no limit, or warn when over budget, never auto-disables. Allowed: unlimited | watch.

jev_budget_usd_per_day.title: Jev · Daily budget (USD)
jev_budget_usd_per_day.description: Daily USD spend threshold, used only when budget mode is "watch". Leave unset for no daily threshold.

jev_budget_usd_per_week.title: Jev · Weekly budget (USD)
jev_budget_usd_per_week.description: Weekly USD spend threshold, used only when budget mode is "watch". Leave unset for no weekly threshold.

jev_weekly_notice.title: Jev · Weekly scorecard notice
jev_weekly_notice.description: Once-a-week SessionStart scorecard notice naming one integration worth promoting or turning off (Jev enabled only).

jev_budget_min_credit_usd.title: Jev · Min credit alert (USD)
jev_budget_min_credit_usd.description: Optional: warn (once a day, budget.mode=watch only) when the gateway credit balance drops below this USD amount.

jev_integration_speculation.title: Jev integration · Speculation judge
jev_integration_speculation.description: Is this claim unsupported speculation (add-block trust). Allowed: on | shadow | off.

jev_integration_triage.title: Jev integration · Message triage
jev_integration_triage.description: Mesh message urgency/kind labeling (advisory trust). Allowed: on | shadow | off.

jev_integration_new_request.title: Jev integration · New-request classification
jev_integration_new_request.description: Classify a prompt as new-request/follow-up/correction/question (advisory trust). Allowed: on | shadow | off.

jev_integration_claim_ledger.title: Jev integration · Claim ledger
jev_integration_claim_ledger.description: Is a flagged claim genuinely unsupported by evidence (relax-block trust). Allowed: on | shadow | off.

jev_integration_output_verify_guard.title: Jev integration · Output-verify guard
jev_integration_output_verify_guard.description: Does this test-runner output actually indicate a pass (advisory trust). Allowed: on | shadow | off.

jev_integration_git_guard_self_credit.title: Jev integration · Git-guard self-credit
jev_integration_git_guard_self_credit.description: Does this commit/PR message contain paraphrased AI self-credit (add-block trust). Allowed: on | shadow | off.

jev_integration_model_routing.title: Jev integration · Model routing
jev_integration_model_routing.description: Is this agent-spawn task actually mechanical (relax-block trust). Allowed: on | shadow | off.

jev_integration_tasklist_trivial.title: Jev integration · Tasklist trivial-skip
jev_integration_tasklist_trivial.description: Is this session a genuinely non-trivial, multi-part effort (relax-block trust). Allowed: on | shadow | off.

jev_integration_codex_nudge_substantial.title: Jev integration · Codex-nudge substantial-skip
jev_integration_codex_nudge_substantial.description: Are these file edits genuinely substantial, not just formatting (relax-block trust). Allowed: on | shadow | off.

jev_integration_merge_gate_hedge.title: Jev integration · Merge-gate hedge
jev_integration_merge_gate_hedge.description: Does this text hedge on merge-readiness (relax-block trust). Allowed: on | shadow | off.

jev_integration_parent_gate_question.title: Jev integration · Parent-gate question
jev_integration_parent_gate_question.description: Is this unread child message really a question awaiting a reply (add-block trust, cache-only). Allowed: on | shadow | off.

jev_integration_supervisor_blocker_label.title: Jev integration · Supervisor blocker label
jev_integration_supervisor_blocker_label.description: Is a stale child waiting-on-parent or genuinely wedged (advisory trust, cache-only). Allowed: on | shadow | off.

jev_integration_finding_dedup.title: Jev integration · Finding dedup
jev_integration_finding_dedup.description: Do two deadly-loop TRIO findings describe the same underlying issue, for advisory duplicate-grouping (advisory trust). Allowed: on | shadow | off.

jev_integration_post_handover_gate.title: Jev integration · Post-handover gate
jev_integration_post_handover_gate.description: Does this new request fit in the remaining post-handover context budget (advisory trust; shadow = logged only, never changes the gate). Allowed: on | shadow | off. Default off — an offline benchmark showed no gain over the agent's own size judgment plus the measured budget backstop.

devswarm_hivecontrol.title: DevSwarm · hivecontrol path
devswarm_hivecontrol.description: Explicit path to the hivecontrol CLI binary (default: PATH lookup).

devswarm_supervisor_mode.title: DevSwarm · Supervisor mode
devswarm_supervisor_mode.description: Force the DevSwarm supervisor context on/off, or auto-detect. Allowed: auto | on | off.

devswarm_required_gates.title: DevSwarm · Required merge gates (csv)
devswarm_required_gates.description: Merge gates required for DevSwarm tasks.

devswarm_inbox_cmd.title: DevSwarm · Inbox command
devswarm_inbox_cmd.description: Consumer-configured command to read pending mesh messages (no built-in default).

devswarm_auto_archive_mode.title: DevSwarm · Auto-archive
devswarm_auto_archive_mode.description: Auto-archive finished workspaces, needs DevSwarm >= 2.5.3. Allowed: on | dry-run | off.

devswarm_auto_archive_idle_min.title: DevSwarm · Auto-archive idle minutes
devswarm_auto_archive_idle_min.description: Minutes idle before a finished workspace is eligible for auto-archive.

devswarm_auto_archive_max_per_sweep.title: DevSwarm · Auto-archive max per sweep
devswarm_auto_archive_max_per_sweep.description: Max workspaces auto-archived in one sweep.

devswarm_auto_archive_ignore_pings.title: DevSwarm · Auto-archive ignores status pings
devswarm_auto_archive_ignore_pings.description: Idle timer ignores a finished workspace's own mailbox-wake, heartbeat and status turns. Real work still resets it.

statusline_base.title: Statusline · Base command
statusline_base.description: Shell command run as the line-1 base in consolidated statusline mode.

statusline_no_email.title: Statusline · Hide email
statusline_no_email.description: Suppress the email segment in the statusline.

codex_nudge_enabled.title: Codex Nudge · Codex hand-off nudge
codex_nudge_enabled.description: Enable the Codex hand-off nudge hook.

defects_default_proj.title: Defects · Default project tag
defects_default_proj.description: Default project tag used when filing an anti-hall defect (max 64 chars).

guards_edit_guard_allow.title: Guards · Edit-guard extra allow globs (safety)
guards_edit_guard_allow.description: Extra allowed file globs for edit-guard (comma/colon separated). Safety guard: only you can change it (here or via env); agents cannot.

guards_allow_subagent_mailbox.title: Guards · Allow subagent mailbox access (safety)
guards_allow_subagent_mailbox.description: One-off allow for the subagent-mailbox command pattern. Safety guard: only you can change it (here or via env); agents cannot.

guards_allow_read_only_verify.title: Guards · Allow bounded read-only verification
guards_allow_read_only_verify.description: command-guard "narrow allow": lets the coordinator run a bounded, single-target read-only verification command (piped to tail/head/grep -c/grep -m N/wc, no other unaccounted segment, no write redirect outside scratchpad/tmp) instead of delegating to a subagent.

guards_allow_read_only_verify_scripts.title: Guards · Allow read-only verify of a script file
guards_allow_read_only_verify_scripts.description: command-guard read-only verify, script form: lets the coordinator run an interpreter (python, node, ruby, perl, php) on an existing script file with --check/--dry-run/--list, piped to a bounded sink, inline. Inline code (-c/-e/-m/--eval), stdin/heredoc scripts and wrapper verbs never qualify. Requires the read-only verify allowance.

guards_project_command_allow.title: Guards · Per-project command allowlist
guards_project_command_allow.description: command-guard per-project allowlist: a repo may declare its own sanctioned exact commands in <repo-toplevel>/.anti-hall/command-allow.json, run inline in the main thread only. Default empty config means no behavior change.

guards_project_edit_allow.title: Guards · Per-project doc-edit allowlist
guards_project_edit_allow.description: edit-guard per-project allowlist: a repo may list repo-relative globs in <repo-toplevel>/.anti-hall/edit-allow.json that the main thread may edit directly. Applies only after you trust that exact file content (settings.js trust-edit-allow); an edit to the file revokes trust. Never matches outside the repo, .git, .anti-hall, .claude, .codex, hooks config or ~/.claude.

guards_allow_plain_push.title: Guards · Allow plain git add/commit/push
guards_allow_plain_push.description: command-guard "allow plain push": in the main thread only, lets git add/git commit/a plain git push (to the current branch, no force/mirror/delete/refspec flags), and &&/; chains of only those three, run inline instead of being delegated.

guards_allow_gcloud_reads.title: Guards · Allow read-only gcloud
guards_allow_gcloud_reads.description: command-guard narrow read-only gcloud: in the main thread only, lets gcloud auth print-access-token, gcloud <group> <describe|list|get-iam-policy|read> --format=json|yaml|value(...), and a token-authorized curl -s GET to an https googleapis.com URL (piped or size-capped) run inline. Mutating verbs, curl POST/data/upload/output flags and chained commands stay blocked.

guards_allow_background_scratch_scripts.title: Guards · Allow background scratch scripts
guards_allow_background_scratch_scripts.description: command-guard: in the main thread only, a run_in_background Bash call may run one python3/node/sh/bash script file located in the session scratchpad or a tmp dir. No inline code, chaining, pipes or substitution; foreground runs keep the normal rules.

guards_model_routing.title: Guards · Model-routing guard mode
guards_model_routing.description: model-routing-guard (PreToolUse Agent/Task): strict blocks a mis-tiered spawn, advisory only warns, off disables the hook. Allowed: strict | advisory | off.

guards_model_routing_deploy_floor.title: Guards · Model-routing deploy/secret floor
guards_model_routing_deploy_floor.description: Minimum model for deploy/migration/rollback/production/secret/credential-shaped agent spawns: at or above it the spawn is never blocked, below it (or with no explicit model) it gets an advisory. Allowed: sonnet | opus | off (off restores the plain routing table).

guards_api_guard.title: Guards · API guard
guards_api_guard.description: api-guard (PreToolUse Write/Edit): block fabricated stdlib/builtin APIs in written code.

guards_speculation_guard.title: Guards · Speculation guard
guards_speculation_guard.description: speculation-guard (Stop): block a turn that ends on unverified hedged claims.

guards_claim_ledger.title: Guards · Claim ledger
guards_claim_ledger.description: claim-ledger (Stop, never blocks): record claims in the last reply that nothing in the session backs.

guards_task_guard.title: Guards · Task guard
guards_task_guard.description: task-guard (Stop): block stopping while tracked tasks are still open.

guards_task_guard_owner_blocked_marker.title: Guards · Task guard owner-blocked marker
guards_task_guard_owner_blocked_marker.description: Honor an explicit owner-blocked marker (metadata.blockedOn:'owner'/'user'/'human', or an "OWNER:" subject prefix) as non-dispatchable in task-guard's IDLE NEGLECT check, instead of requiring a fake blockedBy dependency.

guards_tasklist_guard.title: Guards · Task-list guard
guards_tasklist_guard.description: tasklist-guard (Stop): require a task list / progress file for multi-step work.

guards_scan_throttle.title: Guards · Scan throttle
guards_scan_throttle.description: scan-throttle (PreToolUse Bash): run heavy repo-wide scans at background priority (nice/taskpolicy).

guards_silent_agent_nudge.title: Guards · Silent agent nudge
guards_silent_agent_nudge.description: Nudge once, advisory-only, when a background subagent has no terminal notification and a stale/missing output file. Never kills anything.

guards_silent_agent_nudge_min.title: Guards · Silent agent nudge minutes
guards_silent_agent_nudge_min.description: Minutes of silence before the silent-agent nudge fires.

safety_git_guard.title: Safety Guards · git-guard (force-push / AI credit)
safety_git_guard.description: git-guard: block force-push and AI self-credit in commits and gh pr/issue/release bodies. Safety guard: only you can change it (here or via env); agents cannot.

safety_command_guard.title: Safety Guards · command-guard (heavy-command delegation)
safety_command_guard.description: command-guard core: make the coordinator delegate heavy commands (build/test/deploy/push). Its data-safety sub-guards (DevSwarm read/send/mailbox, armed stash guard) stay on. Safety guard: only you can change it (here or via env); agents cannot.

safety_edit_guard.title: Safety Guards · edit-guard (edit delegation)
safety_edit_guard.description: edit-guard core: make the coordinator delegate file edits outside its own plan/state/handover files. Safety guard: only you can change it (here or via env); agents cannot.

safety_swarm_guard.title: Safety Guards · swarm-guard (spawn-rate / memory)
safety_swarm_guard.description: swarm-guard: block agent spawns past the spawn-rate cap or under critical memory pressure. Safety guard: only you can change it (here or via env); agents cannot.

context_verify_first_session.title: Context Injections · Verify-first at session start
context_verify_first_session.description: verify-first-full (SessionStart): inject the full verify-first protocol (also re-injected after compaction).

context_verify_first_orchestration.title: Context Injections · Orchestration discipline at session start
context_verify_first_orchestration.description: verify-first-orch (SessionStart): inject the orchestration discipline for the main thread.

context_verify_first_turn.title: Context Injections · Per-turn verify-first nudge
context_verify_first_turn.description: verify-first (UserPromptSubmit): the short per-turn verify-first nudge.

context_verify_first_subagent.title: Context Injections · Verify-first in subagents
context_verify_first_subagent.description: verify-first-subagent (SubagentStart): inject the protocol into every subagent.

context_task_tracker.title: Context Injections · Task-list directive
context_task_tracker.description: task-tracker (UserPromptSubmit): the task-list discipline directive and per-turn reminder.

context_handover_resume.title: Context Injections · Handover resume pointer
context_handover_resume.description: handover-resume (SessionStart): point a fresh or compacted session at the newest handover.

context_defect_nudge.title: Context Injections · Defect-channel nudge
context_defect_nudge.description: defect-nudge (SessionStart): the once-a-day note about the defect channel.

maintenance_repair_on_reload.title: Maintenance · Repair on reload
maintenance_repair_on_reload.description: repair-on-reload (SessionStart/UserPromptSubmit): re-apply safe doctor repairs after a plugin update.

maintenance_progress_prune.title: Maintenance · Progress-file prune
maintenance_progress_prune.description: progress-prune (SessionStart): archive stale per-session progress files into the history ledger.

maintenance_precompact_snapshot.title: Maintenance · Pre-compact snapshot
maintenance_precompact_snapshot.description: precompact-snapshot (PreCompact): write a mechanical continuation snapshot before compaction.

maintenance_task_lifecycle_log.title: Maintenance · Task lifecycle log
maintenance_task_lifecycle_log.description: task-lifecycle-log (TaskCreated/TaskCompleted): append task events to the per-session history ledger.

maintenance_session_end_reaper.title: Maintenance · Session-end MCP reaper
maintenance_session_end_reaper.description: session-end-mcp-reaper (SessionEnd): kill orphaned MCP-server processes this session left behind.

devswarm_parent_gate.title: DevSwarm · Parent Stop gate
devswarm_parent_gate.description: devswarm-parent-gate (Stop): make a Primary attend to a child with unread mail or a stale verdict before stopping.

devswarm_child_gate.title: DevSwarm · Child Stop gate
devswarm_child_gate.description: devswarm-child-gate (Stop): make a child workspace heartbeat/report to its parent before going idle.

devswarm_parent_inbox.title: DevSwarm · Primary roster/inbox injection
devswarm_parent_inbox.description: devswarm-parent-inbox (UserPromptSubmit): inject the workspace roster and unread child mail into a Primary.

devswarm_child_turn.title: DevSwarm · Child per-turn mail injection
devswarm_child_turn.description: devswarm-child-turn (UserPromptSubmit): inject a child workspace's pending mail each turn.

devswarm_child_role.title: DevSwarm · Child role injection
devswarm_child_role.description: devswarm-child-role (SessionStart): inject the mesh-only messaging directive into Primary and child sessions.

devswarm_child_drain.title: DevSwarm · Child drain tracker
devswarm_child_drain.description: devswarm-child-drain (PostToolUse Bash): re-surface a child's unread mail mid-task (throttled).

devswarm_parent_reply_tracker.title: DevSwarm · Parent reply tracker
devswarm_parent_reply_tracker.description: devswarm-parent-reply-tracker (PostToolUse Bash): record the Primary's direct replies so the parent gate can tell read from answered.

devswarm_comms_guard.title: DevSwarm · Comms guard
devswarm_comms_guard.description: devswarm-comms-guard (PreToolUse SendMessage): block SendMessage to a DevSwarm workspace (mesh messaging only).

devswarm_inbox_read_guard.title: DevSwarm · Inbox read guard
devswarm_inbox_read_guard.description: inbox-read-guard (PreToolUse Read): block raw Read-tool reads of the DevSwarm inbox/store (use the wrapper).

devswarm_wake_watch.title: DevSwarm · Wake watcher
devswarm_wake_watch.description: devswarm-wake-watch monitor: wake an idle session the moment new mesh mail lands (the cron fallback stays).

devswarm_app_sync.title: DevSwarm · App-DB sync
devswarm_app_sync.description: Supervisor app-DB sync: apply the DevSwarm app database (archive state, names, drift) every tick.

devswarm_screenshot_sync.title: DevSwarm · Screenshot sync
devswarm_screenshot_sync.description: devswarm.js sync-ui: reconcile a transcribed sidebar screenshot against the app DB.

devswarm_spawn_strict_flag_values.title: DevSwarm · Spawn refuses option-shaped flag values
devswarm_spawn_strict_flag_values.description: devswarm.js spawn: refuse when -s/--source, -a/--agent, -t/--title or -p/--prompt has no value or is given what looks like the next option (so -t -p "brief" cannot silently make -p the title).

devswarm_send_multi_recipient.title: DevSwarm · Send to several recipients
devswarm_send_multi_recipient.description: devswarm.js send: --to <id1>,<id2> or a repeated --to sends the same message to each recipient, tries every one even after a failure, and exits non-zero if any failed. Off restores the old parsing (last --to wins).

devswarm_spawn_from_origin.title: DevSwarm · Spawn from origin
devswarm_spawn_from_origin.description: devswarm.js spawn: fetch origin and fast-forward the local default branch first, so a child never starts from stale tooling.

devswarm_spawn_fetch_ttl_sec.title: DevSwarm · Spawn fetch TTL (sec)
devswarm_spawn_fetch_ttl_sec.description: devswarm.js spawn: skip the origin fetch when the remote-tracking ref was already updated within this many seconds (0 = always fetch).

devswarm_parent_gate_busy_fresh_min.title: DevSwarm · Parent gate busy window (min)
devswarm_parent_gate_busy_fresh_min.description: A child counts as busy only if its transcript was written within this many minutes and its latest turn is real work. A live process or heartbeat alone never counts.

devswarm_parent_gate_busy_max_age_min.title: DevSwarm · Parent gate busy mail age cap (min)
devswarm_parent_gate_busy_max_age_min.description: Even a busy child blocks the Primary's Stop once its oldest unread message is older than this many minutes.

devswarm_parent_gate_neglect_grace_min.title: DevSwarm · Parent gate neglect grace window (min)
devswarm_parent_gate_neglect_grace_min.description: A plain unread backlog younger than this many minutes never counts as neglect on the Primary's Stop gate by itself, independent of busy — gives a just-sent message time to be read before it is treated as neglected. Never applies to store-only rows, and never suppresses an unanswered child question or an escalation.

devswarm_spawn_create_timeout_ms.title: DevSwarm · Spawn create timeout (ms)
devswarm_spawn_create_timeout_ms.description: Timeout for the hivecontrol workspace create call spawn makes; only our own child process is killed on timeout.
